Anyone with a passion for finance and a drive to grow, be it a mutual fund distributor, financial advisor, financial influencer, part-time trader or full-time professional. No prior experience required, the person should be 12th passed. Q2. Is there any joining fee? Ans. No. Rupeezy's AP program starts with zero joining fee. There are the only registration charges by the NSE.

Our subscription fee starting at Rs 2.5K can be deducted from the commissions earned. Q3. What is the difference between an Authorized Person and a Sub-Broker? Ans. They are functionally similar. Authorized Person (AP) is the SEBI-approved model that replaced the sub-broker system after 2009. Rupeezy follows this updated, compliant model. Q4. How do I earn as an AP? Ans.

You earn 100% of the brokerage generated by your referred clients. The more your clients trade or invest, the more you earn. Q5. When and how do I receive payouts? Ans. Payouts are processed daily and can be instantly withdrawn via the RISE Portal.

A mutual fund distributor or mutual fund agent is an individual or a financial intermediary who helps investors buy/sell and manage their mutual fund investments. Q2. What is the eligibility to become a mutual fund distributor? Ans. A mutual fund distributor operates under the purview of SEBI and AMFI.

The following eligibility criteria must be met to become a mutual fund distributor: Qualification: Age 18+; There is no specific degree required to become an MFD Certification: Must pass NISM-Series-V-A certification test, as mandated by SEBI. ARN (AMFI Registration Number) is issued upon completion of this certification.

Empanelment: After receiving the ARN, candidates can empanel themselves as mutual fund distributor with Rupeezy. Code of Conduct: Mutual fund distributors must adhere to stipulated rules and code of conduct, any violation can lead to de-registration and penal action.

MF distributors are expected to fulfil following roles and responsibilities: Investor Education: The main responsibility of an MFD is to educate investors about mutual funds, types of MF investments, their workings, past performance, risks, features and overall benefits. Execution Assistance: MFD assists in executing the purchase of mutual funds in a timely and efficient manner.
